text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Happy b-day~! Let's hit that cafe in front 
of the station to celebrate. It's our 
treat today anyway♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Waaah! You guys remembered!\nThank you 
both so much!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Still, I actually have a shift at that 
very cafe today~! I really appreciate the 
invite, but... I'm so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah yeah, totally fine, totally fine. The 
folks at the shop will celebrate with us 
too!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
When I explained the situation, the store 
manager said they'd gladly jump on board 
too.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So yeah, Ines-san, you're a guest today. 
Us and the shop staff are gonna give you 
the royal treatment☆

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I never thought I'd end up borrowing the 
shop's uniform, but... just for today, I 
suppose.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh!? Th-Things are getting crazy out 
here!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Well... my senior has done a lot for me, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
We're even serving a limited-edition 
dessert that City and I came up with. So 
you better be ready, got it~?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Thank you... I can't hold back my 
excitement! I'm sure this will be an 
unforgettable birthdayâª
